_comment: EXCLUSION DECLARATION: Keys 'spawnSubagentOnClarify' and 'agentMentions' do NOT exist in this plugin (0 hits in codebase). Do not add them here. See guide.md §14 for valid configuration keys. NOTE: the plugin performs a READ-ONLY probe of the separate pi-subagents config .pi/subagents.json (agentMentions) to surface the 'model' rewrite mode; it never writes or overwrites that file.
_comment_spawnWaitTimeoutMs: Safety-net wait (ms) before escalating to manual handling while a same-named subagent is still live. Shared by stage-spawn deferral (G3) and confirm-gate deferral (G5/G7). Must be a positive integer; invalid values warn and fall back to 120000.
_comment_piWorkDir: Plugin-owned asset directory (relative to projectRoot). Default ".pi". All ".pi/"-prefixed config values (auditDir, domainDir, stage agentPath, verifyFile) are rewritten to this directory at resolve time. EXCEPTION: the config anchor file `.pi/pipeline_loop.json` is NEVER affected by this setting — it always lives at `.pi/pipeline_loop.json`. Constraints: non-empty string, relative path, no '..' segments; invalid values warn and fall back to ".pi". Changing this value requires re-running /pipeline-init and restarting pi to take effect.
_comment_maxLoopCycles: Maximum rework loop cycles (review↔fix rounds); default 5

protect._comment_allow: Add paths here to exempt from gitignore protection (prefix match). Example: ["docs/"] exempts docs/** from gitignore blocking. NOTE: allowedWritePaths per-stage is NOT the exemption channel — use protect.allow for gitignore exemption.
protect._comment_whitelistMiss: 218 F.2: behavior when a write misses the stage allowedWritePaths whitelist (or targets outside the project root via bash file-arg). "ask" (default) = one interactive decision per tool call; "deny" = pre-218 hard block + violation counting; "allow" = pass with throttled audit (managed hosts). NEVER relaxes hardcoded/gitignore protection, git policy, destructive commands or read-only deliverables. Not set here = "ask".
protect._comment_whitelistMiss_forms: String shorthand: "deny". Object form: { "whitelistMiss": { "mode": "ask", "stages": { "review": "deny" } } } — the stages table overrides per stage; highest priority is the single value inside a stage block: stages.fix.protect.whitelistMiss = "allow".

_comment_docs: stageDirs maps each pipeline stage to the project-relative directory whose .md documents are offered as candidates by the /pipeline-start doc menu (single-select, newest first, max 5). When this block is absent the plugin auto-matches: docs/design for clarify/plan/design-review/develop/review and docs/review for fix. These directories do NOT interact with protect.
_comment_archive: dirs is the /pipeline-archive scan scope (recursively, all file types, mtime-based); the .pi/audit directory is ALWAYS scanned on top of it. dest is the archive landing directory resolved against your HOME directory (relative values) — zip files are named yyyy_MM_dd_HHmmssSSS_pipeline.zip (local timezone, millisecond tail). Optional namesuffix appends a sanitized project-name fragment: ..._pipeline_my-project.zip; whitespace/reserved filename characters of namesuffix are replaced with '-', an empty sanitized result is ignored (plain naming). When the target zip already exists the run FAILS CLOSED (no zip, no source deletion). When dirs is absent the scan scope is derived from docs.stageDirs values, falling back to ["docs"]. The active pipeline's requirementDoc and its same-base Plan/Commit/Review documents are never archived or deleted.
